title: PBC implies injective acyclicity
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism]. If $\mathrm{PBC}(f)$ holds for torsion abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-property], then $\mathrm{IA}_r(f)$ holds for every prime $r$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-injective-acyclicity-property]. Explicitly, after any cartesian base change [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], the higher direct images $R^qf'_*g'^{-1}I$ vanish for $q>0$ for every injective sheaf $I$ of $\mathbf F_r$-modules on $X_{\Et}$.
